name: m4-release-main-int
description: Full compile of scalap on the M4: the 2.13.18 release vs 2.13.x (main) vs retronym's refreshed `scala2-perf-integration`, each build in its own forks (one scala-library each, so not paired).
All three are compiled with the release optimizer settings (`-opt:l:inline -opt-inline-from:scala/**`, the lab's `SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`), Temurin 21, ~50 s warmup, 2 rounds.

variantDescriptions.int: `scala2-perf-integration` refreshed onto `278cab1040`: open perf PRs scala/scala#11307, #11306, #11312, #11350, #11352, #11353 rebased, plus the Symbol.filter allocation fix
